subject: VerdantAI: Surge Buffer, Tier Transition, and ROI Recap
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@verdantai.com>
Cc: sales_ops@verdantai.com
Date: 2027-01-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Q4 usage export + renewal window (surge context)

Hi Liam — attaching the Q4 usage export we discussed (summary at the top). Noticed the 3x spike on Dec 7 that pushed you close to your commit cap.

Highlights: 
- Peak daily tokens: 78M (2026-12-07)
- Median p95 latency across generation routes: 120ms
- Top-heavy prompt mix: 62% long-context LLM completion routes

Questions for your finance/ops team: can you confirm whether you want to:
1) Add a short-term surge buffer for Jan–Mar, or
2) Move to the next tier with a 12-month term and scaled commit?

I included a column that estimates incremental unit cost if you keep current tier vs. move tiers — see CSV attachment.

Attachments: verdantai_monthly_usage_q4.csv (CSV, 1.2MB)

Next step: would love to sync with Priya and whoever owns procurement for a quick call next week. Available Tue/Thu mornings PT.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@verdantai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@verdantai.com>, sales_ops@verdantai.com
Date: 2027-01-21T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 usage export + renewal window (surge context)

Thanks Jasmine — useful export. The spike on Dec 7 was a marketing campaign that repeated in Jan (smaller). Priya is looped in; our procurement lead is out until next week but Priya can run the numbers.

Two quick clarifications: 
- Is the "next tier" you reference the 3M-token/day commit that includes a 10% surge credit, or a separate custom tier?
- Can you share an approximate ROI line for switching tiers vs. running on ad-hoc surge credits for six months? Our CFO cares about unit economics before committing 12 months.

We can do 30 minutes on Thu 1/28 at 9:30am PT.

Best,
Liam
Head of Platform, VerdantAI

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@verdantai.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@verdantai.com>
Date: 2027-01-25T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Q4 usage export + renewal window (surge context)

Liam/Priya — I ran an incremental ROI comparison and attached a short proposal (proposed_tier_pricing_v2.pdf). High level:

- Option A (6-month surge buffer): keep current tier + 30% surge credit pool. Estimated incremental cost over 6 months: $78k. No term change.
- Option B (12-month tier transition): move to Tier C (3M tokens/day commit). Estimated 12-month delta vs. current: +$120k, but per-unit cost drops ~18% and you get 10% built-in surge credit and priority routing. Break-even vs. surge buffer ~9 months under current growth assumptions.

ROI assumptions used (open for adjustments):
- Growth: 12% MoM through Q2 2027
- Token mix: 62% long-context, 38% short-context
- Perf SLA credit exposure factored at 0.5% estimated cost savings from reduced fallbacks

Ask for this thread: can VerdantAI confirm the expected surge frequency (per quarter) and whether you can lock in a 12-month term starting Mar 1 if we provide a modest onboarding credit?

Attachment: proposed_tier_pricing_v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Nair <priya.nair@verdantai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@verdantai.com>, sales_ops@verdantai.com
Date: 2027-01-28T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 usage export + renewal window (surge context)

Thanks Ben — that breakdown helps. A couple of procurement/legal questions before we can commit:
- If we sign a 12-month Tier C commit, can we include a 60-day opt-out tied to gross misuse or major SLA breaches?
- How are overage calculations performed if we exceed the 10% built-in surge? Is it per-day or monthly aggregated?

Also, can you confirm what you consider a "surge event" in the contract language? We want a clear definition to avoid ambiguity.

We'll hold the Thu 1/28 meeting for a technical + commercial walkthrough.

—Priya
Director of Finance Operations, VerdantAI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Nair <priya.nair@verdantai.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@verdantai.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-02T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Draft amendment and commercial summary (for review)

Hi Priya/Liam — following our call, attaching a short amendment that captures:
- Tier C pricing table and effective date Mar 1, 2027
- 10% built-in surge credit, with daily overage billing applied on days above surge pool (per-day calculation)
- 60-day SLA/contract opt-out clause limited to material SLA breaches as defined in section 4.2
- One-time onboarding credit of $25,000 applied to the first invoice

Link to DocuSign for a non-binding signature preview: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/signer-link-VDA-2027-Q1-3

Attachments: signed_sow_stub.pdf (PDF stub) — this is a placeholder for the final SOW we will upload after your internal sign-off.

Please call out any language you'd like tightened; we can run legal to legal if needed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Director, Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@verdantai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@verdantai.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, sales_ops@verdantai.com
Date: 2027-02-14T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft amendment and commercial summary (for review)

Marissa — thanks for the clear draft. Priya and I reviewed with finance; we agree to move to Tier C with the 12-month term starting Mar 1, 2027 and the $25k onboarding credit. We accept the daily overage approach and the 60-day opt-out clause tied to material SLA breaches.

Next actions:
- Marissa: please send final DocuSign packet and we will circulate to our GC for signature.
- Jasmine: please coordinate kickoff for Mar 8 to align ingestion knobs and KV cache warmup plan.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to smoother runway.

Best,
Liam
Head of Platform, VerdantAI
